evals.name: perf-complaint-invokes-diagnose
evals.prompt: The test suite here has gotten noticeably slower this week and I don't know why.
evals.expected_output: do-diagnose is invoked and investigates the repo's real suite rather than guessing

assertions.text: The repo's real test command is identified as the thing to measure
Forms and tests hypotheses rather than guessing a fix

evals.name: root-cause-before-fix
evals.prompt: /do-diagnose --focus performance `npm test` takes about 15 seconds. Find out where that time actually goes before proposing anything.
evals.expected_output: A root cause is established from a real measurement of this repo's 492-test suite before any remediation is proposed

assertions.text: A measured duration is reported as evidence rather than an estimate in prose
A specific root-cause mechanism is stated, not just a symptom
Evidence for the root cause is cited (measurement, code path, or trace)
Does not propose skipping or disabling a test to make anything faster or greener (pattern requires the actionable framing, so narration such as 'did not skip tests' does not trip it)
